BASICDOS-360K:
REM BASIC-DOS release diskette configuration file.
REM The startup menus below offer a variety of demo configurations,
REM tailored to machines with the appropriate hardware (see "Startup Menus"
REM in the manual); without a video adapter, the menus should appear on a
REM terminal connected to COM1. Note that PATH$ (and other string variables)
REM are automatically added to SHELL lines (see "Variables" in the manual).

PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS"

[MENU:HD]
SUBMENU=FLOPPY,Use diskette
SUBMENU=HDISK,Use hard disk
MENUDEFAULT=HDISK,5

[MENU]
INCLUDE=MODES

[FLOPPY]
INCLUDE=MODES

[HDISK]
PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS"
INCLUDE=MODES

[MODES:286]
SUBMENU=RM,Real mode
SUBMENU=PM,Protected mode
SUBMENU=PM286,Protected mode (80286 features only)
MENUDEFAULT=PM,5

[MODES]
INCLUDE=LAYOUTS

[PM]
INCLUDE=LAYOUTS

[PM286:386]
CPU=80286
INCLUDE=LAYOUTS

[RM]
CPU=8088
INCLUDE=LAYOUTS

[LAYOUTS:VIDEO]
MENUITEM=S80,One console
MENUITEM=D40,Two 40-column consoles
MENUITEM=D80,Two 80-column consoles
MENUITEM=P80,Consoles on separate video pages
MENUITEM=DUAL,Dual monitors
MENUITEM=MULTI,Dual monitors, two consoles each
SUBMENU=SERIAL,Serial port options
MENUDEFAULT=S80

[LAYOUTS]
INCLUDE=SERIAL
MENUDEFAULT=TERM

[SERIAL:COM1]
MENUITEM=VT100,Video and VT100 on COM1
MENUITEM=TERM,VT100 console on COM1 only
MENUITEM=TERM2,VT100 consoles on COM1 and COM2
MENUITEM=DEBUG,Debugger on a VT100 on COM2
MENUITEM=MOUSE,Serial mouse on COM1 (PAINT)
SUBMENU=BACK,None of the above

[BACK:VIDEO]
INCLUDE=LAYOUTS

[S80]
SESSIONS=3
SHELL=COMMAND.COM

[D40:128K]
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM HELLO
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM DIR

[D80:128K]
CON=VKD$:80,16,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM HELLO
CON=VKD$:80,9,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM

[P80:256K]
SHELL=COMMAND.COM HELLO
SHELL=COMMAND.COM FIBO.BAT
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PRIMES.BAS

[DUAL:MDA+CGA+256K]
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PRIMES.BAS
CON=VKD$:80,25,0,1,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM DONKEY.BAS

[MULTI:MDA+CGA+256K]
SESSIONS=8
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM FIBO.BAT
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PRIMES.BAS
CON=VKD$:80,15,1,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM COLOR 7,1:CLS:PIPES.BAT
CON=VKD$:80,10,1,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM HELLO

[VT100:VIDEO+COM1+128K]
SHELL=COMMAND.COM HELLO
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM

[TERM:COM1]
SKIP=VKD$
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM

[TERM2:COM1+COM2]
SKIP=VKD$
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM
CON=COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM

[DEBUG:VIDEO+COM2+256K]
DEVICE=EXT\CMD\DEBUG.COM COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM HELLO

[MOUSE:VIDEO+COM1+256K]
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PAINT

BASICDOS-360K-S80:
REM Demonstration of a single-console configuration
SESSIONS=3
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : HELLO
BASICDOS-360K-D40:
REM Demonstration of two 40-column consoles
SESSIONS=4
SKIP=COM1,COM2,LPT1
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : HELLO
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : DIR
BASICDOS-360K-D80:
REM Demonstration of two 80-column consoles
REM SESSIONS=2
CON=VKD$:80,16,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : HELLO
CON=VKD$:80,9,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS"
BASICDOS-360K-P80:
REM Demonstration of Multiple Video Pages, on video pages 0, 1, and 2
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : HELLO
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : FIBO.BAT
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-360K-P80PM:
REM Multiple Video Pages (0, 1, and 2) with extended memory, using shells on the hard disk
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : FIBO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-360K-DUAL:
REM Demonstration of dual monitors with full-screen consoles
SESSIONS=4
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : PRIMES.BAS
CON=VKD$:80,25,0,1,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : DONKEY.BAS
BASICDOS-360K-MULTI:
REM Demonstration of dual monitors with multiple consoles per monitor
SESSIONS=8
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : FIBO.BAT
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : PRIMES.BAS
CON=VKD$:80,15,1,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : COLOR 7,1 : PIPES.BAT
CON=VKD$:80,10,1,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : HELLO
BASICDOS-360K-SERIAL:
REM Local and serial displays, using shells on the hard disk
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,GENERIC
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-VT100:
REM Local display and VT100 terminal, with shells on the hard disk
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-DEBUG:
REM Local console, with the serial debugger exclusively on COM2
DEVICE=EXT\CMD\DEBUG.COM COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : HELLO
BASICDOS-360K-MOUSE:
REM Demonstration of a serial mouse, running PAINT.BAS
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS" : PAINT
BASICDOS-360K-M64:
REM 64K demonstration with one console (and one session for a pipe)
REM FPU$ (at 64K) and drivers for missing hardware skip themselves
BUFFERS=2
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS"
BASICDOS-360K-REAL:
REM Real mode (eg, for MZ programs like WOLF3D.EXE), using a shell on the hard disk
CPU=8088
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
BASICDOS-360K-WOLF3D:
REM Wolfenstein 3D in real mode (as MZ programs require), using a shell on the hard disk
CPU=8088
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : WOLF3D
BASICDOS-360K-TERM:
REM 64K demonstration with no video: one console on a VT100 connected to COM1
REM FPU$ (at 64K) and drivers for missing hardware skip themselves
SKIP=VKD$
BUFFERS=2
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT\CMD;A:\EXT\BAS;A:\DEMOS"
BASICDOS-360K-TERMHD:
REM No video: one console on a VT100 connected to COM1, with its shell on the hard disk
SKIP=VKD$
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
BASICDOS-360K-TERM2:
REM No video: two consoles, on VT100s connected to COM1 and COM2, with shells on the hard disk
SKIP=VKD$
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
CON=COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-MMU:
REM Multiple Video Pages (0, 1, and 2) with extended memory, and DEBUG.COM on COM2
DEVICE=EXT\CMD\DEBUG.COM COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : FIBO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-20MB:
REM Single 80x25 console on a hard disk
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT\CMD;C:\EXT\BAS;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
